edit.statement: If one party owes money to another, the second party also owes money to the first.
edit.subject: owesTo
edit.original: Owing money runs one way: if one party owes money to another, the second does not thereby owe money to the first.
edit.scope: An outstanding monetary obligation from debtor to creditor; reciprocal obligations are possible but not implied.
